audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly claims Wind Wall blocks Rune Prison (W).
audit.why: Rune Prison is a targeted 615-range cage (hardCC + slow flags, no projectile flag) — it lands through Wind Wall. Only Overload (Q) and Spell Flux (E) carry the projectile flag. The mirror audit (ryze__yasuo) reached the identical conclusion and calls this the highest-severity error in its slice.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall eats Overload and Spell Flux for its 4 seconds; Rune Prison roots through it on a 11s rank-1 cooldown, so bait the root before you dash.

edits.before: Ryze's whole trade is Overload (Q) and Rune Prison (W) root — Wind Wall (W) eats his Q and blocks the projectile combo, so once your wall is up he has almost no way to touch you and you walk him down.
edits.after: Ryze's trade is Overload (Q) and Spell Flux (E) into the Rune Prison (W) root — Wind Wall eats the Q and the E, but the root is targeted and lands through it, so open with the wall and never dash into his W.

edits.before: With a crit item your Steel Tempest (Q) and empowered autos out-DPS his mana-gated combo hard; Wind Wall every Rune Prison (W) attempt and he can't root-and-burst you.
edits.after: With a crit item your Steel Tempest (Q) and autos out-DPS his mana-gated combo; you cannot wall Rune Prison (W), so bait the root first and dash in on the 9s gap that follows.

edits.before: You own levels 1-3: Ryze relies on Overload (Q) and the Rune Prison (W) root to trade, and Wind Wall (W) blocks both, so once you have your wall he has no safe damage and you press him off the wave.
edits.after: You own level 1: Ryze trades with Overload (Q) and Spell Flux (E) and Wind Wall (W) blocks both for 4 seconds. Rune Prison is targeted and lands through the wall, so step up only as its 11s cooldown runs.

edits.before: Through levels 4-6 you keep control — your Steel Tempest (Q) pokes him under his mana constraints, Wind Wall denies every root-into-burst attempt, and your knockup plus Last Breath (R) give you real kill pressure he can't match.
edits.after: Through levels 4-6 it is a cooldown race — Wind Wall (25s at rank 1) blanks Overload and Spell Flux for four seconds, but Rune Prison roots through it every 11s, so trade after his W and convert any knockup with Last Breath.
